releasePlan.notes: Flag gates the player callsign login overlay. control=off serves the original title screen directly (invaders-shooter-sprite flag still evaluates against anonymous-player context). v1=on shows the login overlay; after submit, ldClient.identify() re-targets the LD streaming connection to the named player so flags like invaders-shooter-sprite can be evaluated per-callsign. loginEnabled is evaluated once post-initLaunchDarkly() and stored module-scope so restartGame() can reference it. Fail-safe default is 'control'.

releaseIntent._instructions: Human approver: edit freely. action: auto (release on deploy) | hold (do not release yet) | manual (a human runs the release). Structured fields execute; anything else goes in notes (an agent will structure it on the PR for your review). Blank fields = default auto-release on deploy. prerequisites: [{"flagKey": "flag-xyz", "variation": "on"}]. notBefore: YYYY-MM-DD. reference: ticket/doc URL.
